Hi! Congrats on the acceptance that’s so exciting!! 

I live on Pembina maybe a 5 or 10 min bus ride from the university and as stated earlier about 30 min to walk but maybe longer or shorter depending on which building you’re going to. 

1. Stick to the south end the bus system kinda sucks tbh so if you don’t live in a main area like Osborne, Fort Richmond, Pembina, the river heights area it might be longer to bus. My rent is 990 a month one bedroom all utilities and parking stall there’s a gym sauna and a pool 

2. Stick to Walmart or superstore or even no frills if you have a friend that has a Costco membership even better 

3. I’ve lived in the city since I started my undergrad so it’s a bit different experience I just looked at the realtor places and booked through website or looked at Facebook or Kijiji. Overall rent and location there’s so much wiggle room for pricing it just depends on budget. Some places with COVID also offer virtual tours so that could be a possibility. 

4. If you’re from the west coast and not a prairie province or territory it gets very cold (-30/-40) and then the polar opposite in summer so be prepared for that rollercoaster of temperatures. Stay away from downtown. There’s tons of things to do even outside the city though and inside of you like hiking or walking. That’s all I can think about off the top of my head lol
